title: Redundancy audit
subtitle: spa + spa_pos custom code · dd-dev 53e4440 · 31 Oct 2026 · read-only
intro: Pick Oui, Non or À discuter for each item, add a comment if needed, then press Save. Section A are bugs found on the way — recommended first. Every change still goes through the full test run and a browser check before dd-dev.

sections.title: Bugs and safety gaps found by the audit — fix first

items.title: Till: contact link opens the wrong screen
items.today: In the till, the link to a client's contact opens an HR screen (« Resume Line Types ») because a screen number is hard-coded.
items.proposal: Remove our patch; Odoo's own link already opens the right contact.

items.title: Online bookings that auto-confirm earn no commission
items.today: When a website booking is confirmed automatically, it skips the normal confirmation step, so no commission is created for the practitioner.
items.proposal: Use the normal confirmation path for online bookings too.

items.title: A receptionist could mark a booking « Payé » without the till
items.today: The « mark as paid » function is still callable directly (the button is hidden, but the function is open).
items.proposal: Make it internal: only the till can mark a booking paid.

items.title: Old function can undo a payment without refund
items.today: `unlink_from_pos_order` puts a paid booking back to « Confirmé » without any refund (breaks the rule « paid = only cancelled by refund »). Only tests use it.

sections.title: Remove — things nobody can reach anymore

items.title: Group creation / « Ajouter des personnes » wizard
items.today: Only reachable from the group screen we removed. ~330 lines + translations. Tests still use it.
items.proposal: Remove after moving its ~18 tests to the companion path (Gantt → Nouveau).

items.title: Group list/form screens and their dead buttons
items.today: Group form/list/search and « Confirmer le groupe », « Ajouter des personnes », « Voir les réservations » are unreachable. « Annuler les impayés », « Restaurer », « Déplacer le groupe » are still used from the booking form.
items.proposal: Remove the screens and dead buttons; keep the three that are used.

items.title: « Attribuer un praticien » wizard
items.today: Its form button was removed yesterday; the till uses its own route. Nothing calls it.
items.proposal: Remove the wizard and its method.

items.title: Dead till code
items.today: An old « treatment changes » mode in the bookings list (unreachable since 25/10), 3 unused fields, an empty override, and a duplicated « hide discount » patch.

items.title: Small leftovers
items.today: Duplicate « Commissions » menu, two website routes never called, leftovers from the removed legend, a few unused fields and methods, a stray compiled file.

sections.title: Merge — the same thing coded in several places

items.title: Changing a practitioner (and its commission)
items.today: Handled in 3 places (till, booking save, wizard + treatment exchange). During an exchange the commission can be moved twice. The practitioner list is built 4 ways, so the till can offer someone the form would hide.
items.proposal: One helper for « change practitioner + move commission » and one list of available practitioners, used everywhere.

items.title: Room capacity rules
items.today: Checked in 3 places (booking, website booking API, website free-slot list) that disagree: only the booking frees an absent client's place.
items.proposal: One capacity rule used by all three.

items.title: Phone handling
items.today: The same « clean the phone number » code appears 16 times; the phone is stored 3 ways; the duplicate-contact search loads every contact on each booking (could be slow on the real spa).
items.proposal: One phone helper; one fast search.

items.title: Payment checks in the till done 2–3 times on the server
items.today: The same ticket rules run 2–3 times for one payment, and the contact check is a copy of the booking's.
items.proposal: Keep one pre-payment check + one final check; reuse the booking's contact check.

items.title: Group keeps its own copy of the organizer's contact
items.today: ~60 lines keep the group's phone/contact in sync with the organizer's booking; 2 empty groups left on dd-dev.
items.proposal: Read the contact from the organizer's booking; clean empty groups.

items.title: Companion list mirrors each person's booking
items.today: The « people coming together » lines copy 6 fields to/from each person's booking, and the form shows two lists of the same people.
items.proposal: Bigger redesign: one editable list of the group's bookings. Needs a data migration (59 lines on dd-dev). Can wait.

items.title: Safety checks on screen + on the server
items.today: Whole quantities, treatment only from its booking, no discount / 0 DH, practitioner before payment, one person per line: one check on screen for a clear message + one on the server so it can't be bypassed.

items.title: WhatsApp / Twilio code (~900 lines)
items.today: Switched off on dd-dev. Removing it is a business decision, not a cleanup.
